messages:
elaine.w: quick heads-up — scanner flagged CVE-2026-1234 (glibc) in the ephemeral CI base image we ship to builds. need a coordinated rebuild + signing rotation. who can own image rebuilds and KMS key touch?
sam.k: I can drive the rebuilds for linux-amd64 and arm64. question: do we want in-place rebase or create new image tags and gradually flip?
jia.t: prefer new tags + canary flipping. avoids rollback pain. we should also sign images with the new KMS key and publish provenance.
kevin_r: KMS integration note — the current signing key is in prod KMS keyring `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/srv/cryptoKeys/img-sign`. Rotation policy is 90d. If we rotate now we need to update workloads that verify signature (build-bot, runtime verifier).
maya_s: RBAC: the build-bot service account currently lacks kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToVerify on the new key. we need a short-lived grant for rollout window. prefer to create a dedicated role binding for `build-bot@redwood` scoped to the key.
leo_p: for audit logging, we want image-sign events, key-usage logs, and KMS Admin actions in the same retention bucket. suggest adding a structured log with labels { image:..., tag:..., signer:... } so ops can query.
security-bot: vuln-triage created VULN-2026-987 for CVE-2026-1234. severity: high. affected: ephemeral-ci-base:v2025-11, runtime-sidecar:v1.2. Recorded remediation steps and dependency tree in ticket ENGSEC-442.
sam.k: proposed plan:
1) build new base images with glibc patched 
2) sign with new KMS key (pre-create key version)
3) push to staging tags and run canary workflows
4) flip prod tags + rotate signing verification to accept new key then retire old key version
Can we schedule the canary tonight?
kevin_r: timeline OK. I will pre-create key version and grant `roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer` to verifier before canary. After testing, grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoSigner` to the signing job only for the build pipeline.
maya_s: RBAC patch (example):
```
# grant build-bot signer role on key version
kubectl create rolebinding build-bot-kms-signer --clusterrole=cloudkms-signer --serviceaccount=ci:build-bot --namespace=ci
```
We need to document expiration and remove binding in 48h if not used.
leo_p: audit config snippet for Cloud Logging:
```
resource.type = "k8s_cluster" AND protoPayload.methodName:("google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.*" OR "storage.objects.*")
labels.image = "ephemeral-ci-base*"
```
This will let us correlate pushes + key ops.
elaine.w: incident response bits — if we detect unsigned images or signature mismatch post-rotation, runtime fallback policy should reject pulls and trigger oncall. @oncall-bot can we wire a pager if verifier fails 5 consecutive checks?
oncall-bot: configured. will page infra-oncall after 5 verifier errors within 10m. escalation policy: infra -> eng-runtime -> eng-security.
deploy-bot: canary job scheduled: 1799520000 (2026-03-14T01:00:00Z) — will run 100 builds and 10 runtime pulls in staging.
jia.t: vuln triage notes — update dependency list in ENGSEC-442 and add a postmortem template to capture timeline. Also add test to CI that validates glibc version <= patched.
kevin_r: small gotcha — image signatures use PKCS format; verifier needs the public key from the new key version. I'll export it to the verifier config once key is ready.
maya_s: I will prepare the RBAC PR and attach TTL annotations: `rbac.redwood/expiry: 48h` and `rbac.redwood/owner: maya_s`.
sam.k: I'll run the rebuild tonight after PR approvals. pinging @elaine.w once signing key is available.
elaine.w: perfect. thanks everyone. created a 30m sync in #eng-security to walk the checklist at 23:30 UTC. please add any blockers to ENGSEC-442. :thumbsup:
